message.content: The median (i.e., “average” in everyday usage) home price in California is roughly **$800 000–$850 000** as of early 2024. Zillow’s Home Value Index reports a median value of about **$820 000** for the state, with the median in major metro areas (e.g., Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego) ranging from **$900 000 to $1.2 million**. The national average for all U.S. homes is lower, around **$400 000–$450 000**, so California remains well above the national average.
